subject: general
question: What is the purpose of the feedback network in an oscillator circuit?

options.text: To provide a stable output voltage
To provide positive feedback to sustain oscillations

solution:
The **purpose of the feedback network in an oscillator circuit** is: **3) To provide positive feedback to sustain oscillations**

__**Explanation:**__

An **oscillator** generates continuous AC signals without an external input. For sustained oscillations:

__
 
• 
 
The circuit must provide **positive (regenerative) feedback**

 
 
• 
 
The feedback network feeds a portion of the output signal back to the input **in phase**

 
 
• 
 
This satisfies the **Barkhausen criterion** (loop gain ≥ 1 and phase shift = 0° or 360°)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Option 1:** Impedance matching is not the primary role of the feedback network.

 
 
• 
 
**Option 2:** Stable voltage is regulated by voltage regulators, not oscillators.

 
 
• 
 
**Option 4:** Frequency filtering is a secondary effect; the main purpose is sustaining oscillations.
